request:
镜头 s33：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 9 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：raw verite documentary footage shot handheld in 2075 on a high-ISO full-frame documentary camera in available light only: visible sensor noise, deep solid blacks, volumetric haze and silhouettes, true-to-life skin tones, focus occasionally hunting
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持近景，几乎不动。黑暗里，宋念的脸只被头顶的红光照着，她一动不动地看着那枚镜头，嘴唇动了动，轻声说了一句。环境声：远处的喊声、电流声。
情绪：stunned, chilling, quiet
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：close-up, handheld, almost motionless
景深与虚实：Only her eyes sharp; the edges of the face fall into red-tinted darkness.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Raw verité close-up in the darkened command hall: Nian's face lit only by the red glow of the lens above, headset around her neck, staring up, very still. Blocking lock: Nian's face fills frame centre, looking up toward frame top right where the red light comes from; darkness all around.
Picture 2: MOSS terminal (black AI terminal with one red glowing lens) (character reference; role: the central AI's physical presence). Close view of an artificial-intelligence monitoring terminal built into a brushed-steel wall panel of a control hall: a black glass housing with a single round camera lens glowing deep red in its centre, a thin ring of red light around it, faint reflections of people in the glass. Cold, clinical, perfectly clean in contrast with the worn surroundings.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Nian (a woman in her mid-thirties, low, calm, restrained voice) — 宋念（三十多岁女性的声音，低沉、平静、克制）: 它真的……有了自己的想法。
现场环境声：distant shouting, a faint electrical hum
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。
